summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration_81 money-rain fixes, at a 390x844 viewport with demo@amass.africa. FIX-2, FIX-3, FIX-4, FIX-5 and FIX-6 pass, and so do all smoke flows. FIX-1 (reduced motion) is only partly fixed. With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce emulated before load, money-rain-brief renders exactly 5 notes. The notes are static (translateY travel 0, rotation change 0), sit at y≈209-427 inside the 20-55% band, and the layer is removed after ~1.1s. However, every note keeps opacity 0 for the whole run (max opacity 0 across 23 samples, inline style opacity:0 at 300ms, and the screenshot shows no notes). The user with reduced motion sees nothing. The normal path is OK: 12 notes start at y=-51 (above the top edge) and fall to y≈809, with rotation, over ~2.1s.

ui_bugs.issue: Notes are never visible: opacity stays 0 for the whole 1.1s layer lifetime. RCA: Reanimated 4.7.1 withTiming/withDelay default to ReduceMotion.System. When the OS reduce-motion setting is on, Reanimated skips the animation and jumps t straight to 1 (utilCommon.ts getReduceMotionFromConfig). interpolate(1,[0,.3,.65,1],[0,a,a,0]) gives 0, so the designed calm fade never plays. This affects native too. Reference: /app/frontend/src/ui/MoneyRain.tsx:197

react_native_issues.issue: useReducedMotionSync() || useReducedMotionLive() calls a hook conditionally (short-circuit), which breaks the rules of hooks. It is stable today only because Reanimated's value is constant per session. It also means a user who starts the app with reduce motion ON and turns it OFF live keeps the calm variant. Call both hooks unconditionally, then OR the results. Reference: /app/frontend/src/ui/MoneyRain.tsx:58

action_items: HIGH: MoneyRain.tsx:197. Import ReduceMotion from react-native-reanimated and opt the banknote animation out of Reanimated's automatic reduce-motion skip: t.value = withDelay(note.delay, withTiming(1, { duration, easing, reduceMotion: ReduceMotion.Never }), ReduceMotion.Never). The reduced variant is already motion-safe (opacity only). Optionally apply it only when reduce is true. Then re-verify that 5 notes fade in to ~0.7-0.96 opacity and back out.
LOW: MoneyRain.tsx:58. Call both reduced-motion hooks unconditionally: const a = useReducedMotionSync(); const b = useReducedMotionLive(); const reduce = a || b.

rca_of_issue: Reduced motion. Reproduction: emulate reduce, load the app, log in and tap a map pin. The money-rain-brief layer shows 5 children with opacity 0 for 1.1s. Root cause: Reanimated's default ReduceMotion.System makes withTiming/withDelay complete instantly at the toValue, and toValue=1 maps to opacity 0. Mitigation: set reduceMotion: ReduceMotion.Never on the note animation.
